threat_event: Ransomware enters through third-party remote access at a 2024 acquired farm, spreads from farm OT to the corporate cloud network and ERP, and steals personal data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator always-on remote access with shared accounts and no MFA; flat acquired farm networks; farm data hub path between ROC SCADA and the corporate cloud network; farm directory administrators outside PAM
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 PR.IR-01 (benchmark); N42-R07 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); state breach laws
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC and EDR on IT; immutable backups for SYS-G3 and SYS-G4; group PAM for IT
treatment_plan: Replace integrator access with group PAM; OT DMZ at each ROC; farm directory under PAM with MFA; cross-division ransomware tabletop in freeze season

threat_event: Malicious manipulation of operational technology causes crop loss, worker injury, or a chemical release (farm irrigation and fertigation, plant process lines, ammonia refrigeration, blending plants)
threat_source: Cybercriminal or nation-state actor; malicious insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Uneven OT segmentation and monitoring; no logic integrity checks at farms; contractor remote access to refrigeration controls
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 field OT; SYS-D3 plant OT; SYS-D4 blending controllers
existing_controls: Plant OT monitoring at all 11 facilities; group PAM for the refrigeration contractor; legacy farm interlocks
treatment_plan: Logic integrity checks; fail-safe settings at acquired farms; OT monitoring at all farms; review contractor sessions

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more regulator, buyer, customer, cooperative, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix exists only for Farm Supply card data; buyer and customer 24-hour terms, cooperative 72-hour terms, H-2A worker notices, and SEC timing never exercised together
regulatory_driver: N42-R07 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); state breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); buyer and customer contracts
existing_controls: Group IR plan v5; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Common control failures in Crop Farming go unnoticed because inheritance and OT monitoring are undocumented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance documented for Food Processing and Farm Supply but not for the Crop Farming OT estate; OT monitoring at 9 of 38 farms; farm OT not in vulnerability management
existing_controls: Common control catalog; annual internal audit
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix for Crop Farming OT; OT monitoring and scanning at all farms

threat_event: Seasonal workforce identity weaknesses corrupt H-2A earnings and Produce Safety records and leave stale access
threat_source: Insider error or misuse; process gap
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared crew logins at 21 farms; seasonal FMIS accounts not disabled at season end; no seasonal security training in Spanish
existing_controls: HR onboarding with identity proofing; MDM on tablets
treatment_plan: Named crew accounts with tablet PINs; season-end disablement driven by HR; Spanish training module

threat_event: Food defense and food safety plans do not consider cyber manipulation of process controls or of the electronic records they rely on
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 121.130 vulnerability assessments and 117.126 food safety plans treat process controls as physical equipment
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D3 plant OT and quality records
existing_controls: Food defense plans at all 11 facilities (reanalyzed 2024); plant OT monitoring
treatment_plan: Reanalyze vulnerability assessments with cyber attack scenarios; add record integrity controls
owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

threat_event: Traceability records cannot be produced for FDA within 24 hours during a ransomware outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Harvest lot data reaches traceability only by a nightly file from the farm data hub; no tested alternate route
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-D1 farm data hub; SYS-D3 traceability
existing_controls: Daily traceability backups; paper lot tags at farms
treatment_plan: 24-hour records drill with the hub down; signed lot manifests; second transfer route
owner: Group VP Food Safety and Quality

threat_event: Yield model errors flow into forward sales, Food Processing production plans, and growing-crop estimates without change control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No model change control or validation sign-off; outputs used by three functions
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 GV.RM-01 (benchmark); N42-R07 (Reg S-K Item 106 context)
existing_controls: Weekly hand-count spot checks by agronomists
treatment_plan: Group AI Standard change gate; validation before release; finance review of estimates (P10)

threat_event: Grower Agronomy Portal AI prescriptions and data use break commitments to growers and reselling cooperatives
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AI prescription feature launched without security or privacy review; data-use commitments not checked; no SOC 2 report
existing_controls: Portal terms (2025); release testing for functional defects
treatment_plan: Retroactive review; prescription guardrails; SOC 2 readiness (P09)

threat_event: Theft of personal data from shared HR, payroll, and credit files (H-2A passport and visa data, Social Security numbers, personal guarantees)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Copies of H-2A exports found on the farm data hub (purged); grower credit files over-shared; payroll tally staged on the hub
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G4 HR and payroll; grower credit file share; farm data hub
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example); N42-R07
existing_controls: MFA for workforce; immutable backups; DLP on email
treatment_plan: Data map and purge; restrict credit files; monitor bulk access

threat_event: FMIS vendor outage or breach halts tally, records, and the irrigation module at all 38 farms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One vendor tenant for all farms; no farm-held export; vendor RTO 8 hours
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report; contract with security terms
treatment_plan: Monthly records export to the group vault; ROC SCADA runs irrigation without the FMIS
owner: Crop Farming VP Irrigation and Field Technology

threat_event: Compromise of the legacy farm operations directory gives control of all three ROCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 domain administrators outside group PAM, no MFA; directory not monitored by the SOC
existing_controls: Physical security at ROCs
treatment_plan: Bring administrators under PAM with MFA; forward directory events to the SIEM; migrate to SYS-G1 by 2027-12-31

threat_event: Card data compromise at Farm Supply branches or e-commerce
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Card data environment at 120 branches; e-commerce skimming risk
existing_controls: Segmented card data environment; annual report on compliance by a QSA; hosted payment fields
treatment_plan: Maintain; add script integrity monitoring on e-commerce pages

threat_event: SEC materiality decision is late or inaccurate for an incident that starts in farm OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure committee has not rehearsed an OT incident with crop and food safety consequences
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter covers cybersecurity incidents
treatment_plan: Include OT and food safety scenarios and materiality factors in the tabletop

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts payments to growers or suppliers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High payment volumes in harvest; many outside growers and suppliers
existing_controls: Callback verification for bank changes; MFA on email
treatment_plan: Extend callback rule to grower settlements; phishing training for settlement staff

threat_event: OT component or vendor software supply chain compromise (controllers, modems, HMI software, integrator tools)
threat_source: Nation-state or criminal supply chain attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT vendors and integrators not in the group SCRM program
existing_controls: Group SCRM program for IT vendors
treatment_plan: Extend SCRM to OT vendors; require component purchase through authorized channels

threat_event: Hurricane or regional power loss takes out a ROC or plant while cyber recovery depends on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ROC-1 single point for Florida freeze protection; plant OT backups on site
existing_controls: Generators and UPS; hurricane plans
treatment_plan: Warm standby for ROC-1 at ROC-2; offsite OT backups

threat_event: Over-privileged insider in corporate shared services misuses access across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad read access for some shared service roles
existing_controls: PAM; quarterly certification; SOC user behavior rules
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; reviewed yearly

threat_event: Cloud misconfiguration exposes a division data store
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many division accounts; guardrails enforce most settings
existing_controls: Guardrails; configuration monitoring
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; guardrail exceptions reviewed monthly

threat_event: Commodity and USDA contract obligations missed after a Food Processing outage (FAR clauses, delivery terms)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract notice terms not in the incident matrix; FAR 52.204-21 safeguarding not mapped
existing_controls: Contract files reviewed by legal at award
treatment_plan: Add contract rows to the matrix; map FAR 52.204-21 requirements to group controls
owner: Food Processing security and compliance lead
